final:
age_at(born: int, now: int) -> int =
  pre born <= now
  post out >= 0
  post out == now - born
  ex age_at(1990, 2025) == 35
  now - born

test_age_at() =
  assert age_at(1990, 2025) == 35
  assert age_at(2000, 2000) == 0
